conditions: Service-time samples are not emitted and the summary omits mean S, so open-loop 1/S levels cannot be derived from retained evidence.

At injected delay near zero, engine service p50 is 0.242-4.378 microseconds while observed closed-loop logical throughput is only 147-14900 per second. An in-process scheduled generator cannot realize the resulting 0.25x-2x 1/S rates without millions of tasks and missed slots.

The executable marks any repetition with more than 1 percent non-completion invalid, while required overload cells intentionally measure terminal rejection above that level. Pilot hygiene-only cells at 1/S were invalid at 10.0-18.5 percent rejection despite valid ledgers.
K values above 2 fail startup scratch validation, leaving the frozen feasible levels {1,2}.
